Application for Correction and Issuance of MYSY Renewal Certificate and low Attendance 
 
Date: 16/09/2025 
Subject: Apology regarding attendance and humble request for scholarship eligibility and request for 
issuance of MYSY Renewal Certificate instead of delayed certificate  
 
 
Respected Sir/Ma’am, 
 
I, Vaghasiya Nikunj Vinodbhai, a student of B.Tech 5th Sem in Computer Engineering with enrollment 
No. 23DCE123, am studying in your esteemed institute. 
While applying for the Mukhyamantri Yuva Swavalamban Yojana (MYSY) scholarship, my application 
mistakenly generated a Delayed Certificate and my attendance is less than 75% .However, I am 
applying for the Renewal Certificate, not the delayed one. Unfortunately, there is no option available 
to regenerate the renewal certificate in the portal once the delayed certificate has been issued. 
I sincerely apologize for my lower attendance and kindly request you to consider my genuine academic 
performance and circumstances. I assure you that I will improve my attendance in upcoming semesters 
and maintain the required standards as per institute guidelines. 
Therefore, I kindly request you to help me by cancelling the delayed certificate and issuing the MYSY 
Renewal Certificate for the academic year 2025–26, so that I can proceed with my scholarship 
application. 
I sincerely apologize for the inconvenience and assure you that I will take utmost care while applying 
in the future. 
Kindly consider my request and issue the renewal certificate at the earliest. 
 
 
 
Yours sincerely, 
 
 
Vaghasiya Nikunj Vinodbhai 
Enrollment No.: 23DCE123 
B.Tech – Computer Engineering 
5th Sem 
 
 
Counseller Sign  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
HOD Sign
